say:2:1311132001:1.text: The two busts lining this corridor were commissioned in honor of my great-great-grandfather.
say:2:1311132001:1.source_cn: 这走廊两侧的两尊胸像，是为我祖父的祖父而立。

say:3:1311132002:1.text: The Valesa family is nearly as ancient as the Duchy of Whiteridge itself, yet our legacy is on the verge of ending. You see, Yolena was Sigmund's only daughter.
say:3:1311132002:1.source_cn: 瓦勒沙家族的历史几乎与白山一样悠久，然而，属于瓦勒沙的...

say:4:1311132003:1.text: And now, her once vibrant soul has met a tragic fate.
say:4:1311132003:1.source_cn: 曾经那么鲜活明媚的生命，已经宣告终结。

say:5:1311132004:1.text: Why didn't you want Princess Yolena to become a Graveborn?
say:5:1311132004:1.source_cn: 柳博米尔先生，为什么你不愿意亚莲娜公主成为亡灵？

say:6:1311132005:1.text: Sigmund wished for his daughter to live, but being a Graveborn does not truly mean being alive. While it offers eternal existence, it merely means existing in this world without the essence of life.
say:6:1311132005:1.source_cn: 齐格蒙德想要自己的女儿活着，但亡灵……即便永生，也算不...

say:7:1311132006:1.text: To live means there will always come a time for death. Death can sever all pain, everything one wishes to escape, and the ceaseless chatter of the mind.
say:7:1311132006:1.source_cn: 活着，就总有死亡之时。而死亡可以斩断一切痛苦，所有想要...

say:8:1311132007:1.text: Being trapped in this hollow shell is a cruel curse! You witness yourself wither away, watch your loved ones slowly fade, and feel the emptiness consume your soul...
say:8:1311132007:1.source_cn: 不，这不是活着，这是一种恶毒的诅咒！诅咒你看着自己变得...

say:9:1311132008:1.text: If I had been given the choice, I would've refused to become a Graveborn.
say:9:1311132008:1.source_cn: 如果可以选择，我不想成为亡灵。

say:10:1311132009:1.text: I understand that Sigmund loves Yolena deeply, but he must learn to accept his daughter's death, just as... my parents did.
say:10:1311132009:1.source_cn: 我知道齐格蒙德很爱亚莲娜，但他应该学着接受女儿的死亡，...

say:11:1311132010:1.text: Now, please follow me to the study.
say:11:1311132010:1.source_cn: 接下来，一起前往书房吧。
